parameters.name: ClusterType
parameters.description:
The type of the Kubernetes cluster:

- 5: an ACK cluster.

- 7: a self-managed Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return for a paged query. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The default value is 1000.

parameters.name: SubClusterType
parameters.description:
The subtype of the cluster:

- Ask: an ASK cluster.

- ManagedKubernetes: an ACK cluster.
